ana: Evening handoff — I'm wrapping up at 18:15 PT. Quick readiness check before I go. I'll stay available until 18:30. Ping if anything blocked.
ben: Thanks — can you drop the checklist here?
ana?: (typo)
miles: VPN and ssh verified from my laptop. Can reach nonprod: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood nonprod-admin@10.2.3.4`
vijay: I still don't have pager access for the new rota, getting 403 on the PD console. @sre-bot can you re-trigger provisioning for me?
sre-bot: @vijay provisioning job queued — will post update when done. :robot_face:
ana?: (typo)
ana: checklist: 1) VPN + ssh 2) Pager access 3) Vault creds + token expiry 4) Smoke deploy dry-run 5) Confirm runbook link works (esp. incident playbooks). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/oncall/primary-checklist
ben: Vault token for smoke-tests expires in ~3h for me. Recommend rotating service account token before nightly smoke.
miles: Noted. Smoke deploy dry-run command I used: `./scripts/smoke-deploy --dry-run --env=nonprod` — updated flag compared to old runbook.
nana?: (typo)
vijay: sre-bot says provisioning failed with 502, I forwarded the screenshot to infra-ops.
sre-bot: provisioning job failed (502). Opening ticket: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-3921 — assigning to infra-ops.
ben: FYI I added a calendar reminder for TLS cert expiry (2026-04-02) and a brief doc on rotation steps under docs/security/certs.
nana?: (typo)
nana: If anyone can't access vault, here's a quick renew snippet for short-lived tokens:
```
# renew token
vault token renew $VAULT_TOKEN
```
ana: KMS alias to check if you need decrypt rights: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/inf/cryptoKeys/serve-key`
miles: Confirmed runbook link opens for me. Also left a note on the deploy step about switching `--dry-run` to `--check` in CI.
vijay: Once infra-ops fixes provisioning, can someone confirm I'm added to pager-rotation? I won't be able to take the first alert otherwise.
ben: I'll ping infra-ops and follow up here when they ack.
sre-bot: Handoff log created: https://ops-logs.redwood.ai/handoffs/1798765432 — handoff state: in-progress
ana: Thanks all. If pager or vault still broken for anyone, DM me and I'll keep an eye until 18:30 PT. :wave:
